answer: Require matched collateral on BOTH sides of every interaction. To attest or trade with a peer, each party locks an equal bond into that link, slashed if either defects — neither crosses without laying the same shale. A sybil cluster transacting with ITSELF funds both sides from one purse, doubling its capital burn with no outside money entering: the fakes just pass a shrinking pool back and forth, an echo with no new source, while real counterparties bring fresh pigment to the pool. Self-dealing at scale is strictly capital-negative; honest pairs risk little and recover it.
